quantity_dictionary.delta_direct_signed_hartree: saved signed direct PF shift; scorer only
quantity_dictionary.e_direct_hartree: abs(delta_direct_signed_hartree); the direct PF error used by the uncorrected QPE budget
quantity_dictionary.g_rho_others_chord: min_{j != 0} abs(lambda_j-rho); the separation required by the candidate residual bound
quantity_dictionary.g_phase_principal_radian: principal circular separation in [0, pi] between unit-circle eigenvalues
quantity_dictionary.g_energy_unwrapped_hartree: g_phase_principal_radian/t only after a common physical lift is certified
quantity_dictionary.rho: Rayleigh quotient y^* A y of the original normal operator
quantity_dictionary.width_hartree: upper width for abs(delta_hat-delta_0), with a mandatory claim class
quantity_dictionary.w_win: maximum nonnegative width compatible with a fixed resource target

symbol_separation.K_D1: number of retained non-target clusters in the D1 oracle diagnostic

candidate_bound.name: conditional_normal_residual_separation_bound
assumptions: the target eigenvalue lambda_0 is independently identified
g is a valid full-space lower bound
r is evaluated for the original normal operator and lifted vector
inexact action and roundoff are separately bounded

chord_to_phase.inputs: lambda=exp(i theta), rho=a exp(i phi), a>0, abs(lambda-rho)<=d
chord_to_phase.inconsistent_if: d < abs(1-a) beyond numerical identity tolerance
chord_to_phase.acos_clamp: allowed only within a predeclared floating-point tolerance of [-1,1]
chord_to_phase.physical_energy_width: principal_angle_bound/t only when t>0 and the physical phase lift is independently certified

requirements: both endpoints are on the unit circle
the separation is the principal circular separation

resource_value.eta_zero_interpretation: baseline-equal boundary; strict resource improvement requires w < w_win(t;0)

c1_draft.objective: test one fixed residual-separation width and determine whether its required information is operationally obtainable and resource-relevant

arms.operational: truth-free allowlisted inputs only; unavailable full-space separation yields indeterminate
arms.oracle_sensitivity: true gap may be read by scorer only after operational prediction freeze; never counted as deployable success
arms.baseline: saved D2-A empirical width and local-CISD gamma=1.02 with claim-class differences reported

prototype_candidate_requires: the mathematical assumptions pass fixed positive and negative controls
a truth-free full-space separation/reference path is specified
action and roundoff errors are included
the attainable width can cross a predeclared w_win target on at least part of the development set
the information cost does not silently solve the original ground-energy problem
information_cost_or_limit_result_if: only the oracle arm obtains a useful width
the operational information cost is less favorable than a matched margin baseline
the access model yields a quantitative indistinguishability or required-precision result
c1_draft.route_close_if: the work reduces to substituting a true gap into a standard bound and yields neither an operational route nor a useful quantitative limit

unresolved_items: truth-free acquisition of a full-space g_rho_others lower bound
practical effect size and allowed classical information budget
